name: Transmit
tagline: The core loop is small enough for a capable coding agent to produce a useful local version in one sitting. For Transmit, build a focused SFTP and object-storage client with bookmarks and transfer queue. The hard boundary is protocol compatibility, native polish, sync, security, and ongoing maintenance, plus os integration polish and maintenance.
